reviews.method: Gerbonara parses exported manufacturing files; filter-free SVG, explicit white PNG background. Layer contact sheet plus full-size top/bottom copper+outline+hole views inspected.
reviews.orientation: Both copper composites in front-view coordinates. Bottom view is not a mirror fabrication variant.
observations: One closed rectangular contour, four circular corner NPTH holes.
Front copper includes sensor pad groups, lower connector and three MUX pad groups. Back copper links and via holes align.
No unintended solid areas, contours, external copper or gross layer displacement observed.
Front mask openings follow pads; back mask has no openings, consistent with no bottom pads and tented vias.
Both silk layers blank as in source; front clear subtraction primitives do not print legend.
reviews.known_input_deficiency: No visible silkscreen legend on either side.
reviews.disposition: PO/design owner must accept unmarked boards or arrange a separate requalified legend revision.
reviews.limits: Visual screen is not minimum-clearance measurement or manufacturer CAM/DFM approval. Use parsed geometry and source DRC alongside it.
